name: Planted thicket
description: What the evolved weapon leaves standing in the ground: a woody knot with its roots turned out flat around it and three coils wound up out of the middle, waiting to swing. It is drawn low and wide on purpose — the erupting vine is a thing that happens and is gone, this one sits on the field for five seconds while the crowd walks past it, so it has to read as furniture at a glance and never be mistaken for a body. Roots and knot take the camera's own 0.42 squash, the same one the vine's hole takes, which is what sets them on the floor rather than standing them up out of it; the coils are the only thing that leaves the ground, and they are the only thing that does anything. Each coil is wound the opposite way from its neighbour so three of them never print as a fan, and each carries one barb. The barbs are `$gold.light` and the document has no plain variant, because a thicket only exists on the evolved weapon — the gold is in the drawing rather than in a state the base weapon could ask for and would never get. `meta.radius` is the knot's own width, which is what the game scales it by.
